title: Implementation Plan for Interactive 3D Cyber-Grid Retro-Tech Landing Page

steps.description: Create the complete standalone application in index.html including the Three.js 3D scene, custom GLSL shaders for neon/glitch effects, and the glassmorphic UI overlay.
steps.testCriteria: The page must render a 3D wireframe grid with neon effects, respond to mouse movement for Y-axis rotation, and display a functional glassmorphic UI overlay with 'System Status' indicators.

verificationGateChecklist: AST code health clean (no empty catch, no any)
